name: is_anagram
problem_desc: Given two strings a and b, return True if they are anagrams of each other (same letters, same counts, case-insensitive), else False.
reference:
def is_anagram(a, b):
    return sorted(a.lower()) == sorted(b.lower())

buggy.label: case_sensitive
buggy.code:
def is_anagram(a, b):
    return sorted(a) == sorted(b)

buggy.label: uses_set
buggy.code:
def is_anagram(a, b):
    return set(a.lower()) == set(b.lower())
